name: spellbinder
description: Spellbinder helps Magic: The Gathering players search cards and sets, research tournaments and decklists, analyze decks against their collection, compare Standard tournament decks against a budget, and create decks or add cards to their collection and wishlist through ChatGPT.

interface.shortDescription: Find MTG cards and build decks
interface.longDescription: Spellbinder helps Magic: The Gathering players search cards and sets, research tournaments and decklists, analyze decks against their collection, compare Standard tournament decks against a budget, and create decks or add cards to their collection and wishlist through ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Find the latest top-8 Stiflenought deck in Premodern and show me the full decklist
Compare three recent Standard top-8 decks with my Paper collection on a $100 budget
What are the five distinct cards in my Paper collection with the highest owned unit price?
